section_summary.extract_value: This introduction reviews literature on the health-promoting effects of exposure to natural environments and connectedness to nature, drawing on Psychophysiological Stress Recovery Theory and Attention Restoration Theory. It then transitions to discussing emerging research on the relationship between nature-related variables and body image, noting that only a handful of studies have directly tested these associations. The introduction mentions prior work including Swami, von Nordheim, et al. (2016), which found that connectedness to nature was associated with body appreciation (measured by BAS) in women (r = .32) but not men (r = .10), and calls for further research using the revised BAS-2 scale and examining broader aspects of body image.
